yacht.definition: n. an expensive vessel propelled by sail or power and used for cruising or racing\nv. travel in a yacht
yacht.translation: n. 快艇, 游艇\nvi. 驾游艇, 乘游艇

examples.en: Several yachts were sailing side by side far out at sea.
examples.zh: 数艘游艇在远方的海洋并列航行。

examples.en: Our yacht club has ten members.
examples.zh: 我们的游艇俱乐部里有十个会员。

examples.en: The yacht sailed around a buoy.
examples.zh: 游艇绕浮标航行。

yard.definition:
n. a unit of length equal to 3 feet; defined as 91.44 centimeters; originally taken to be the average length of a stride
n. the enclosed land around a house or other building
n. a tract of land enclosed for particular activities (sometimes paved and usually associated with buildings)
n. a tract of land where logs are accumulated
yard.translation: n. 码, 庭院, 工场\n[化] 堆置场

examples.en: It's raining, so the kids aren't playing in the yard.
examples.zh: 正在下雨，孩子们没有在院子里玩儿。

examples.en: Give him an inch and he'll take a yard.
examples.zh: 得寸进尺。

examples.en: Tom cut down a tree in his yard.
examples.zh: 汤姆在后院砍伐了一棵树。

yawn.definition: n. an involuntary intake of breath through a wide open mouth; usually triggered by fatigue or boredom\nv. utter a yawn, as from lack of oxygen or when one is tired
yawn.translation: n. 哈欠\nvi. 打哈欠, 裂开\nvt. 打着哈欠说

examples.en: Cover your mouth when you cough, sneeze, or yawn.
examples.zh: 你咳嗽、打喷嚏或打哈欠的时候要捂住你的嘴。

examples.en: We yawn when we are short of oxygen.
examples.zh: 我们缺氧时就会打哈欠。

year.definition: n. a period of time containing 365 (or 366) days\nn. a period of time occupying a regular part of a calendar year that is used for some particular activity\nn. the period of time that it takes for a planet (as, e.g., Earth or Mars) to make a complete revolution around the sun
year.translation: n. 年, 年度, 年龄\n[经] 年度

examples.en: In March next year, I will fly to the US.
examples.zh: 明年三月我坐飞机去美国。

examples.en: My hope for the new year is to study harder.
examples.zh: 我新年的新希望是更努力地学习。

examples.en: Last year was the first time I went to Geneva.
examples.zh: 去年我第一次去了日内瓦。

yearn.definition: v. have affection for; feel tenderness for
yearn.translation: vi. 渴望, 想念, 怀念, 同情

examples.en: I yearn for the university.
examples.zh: 我渴望上大学。

yell.definition: v. utter or declare in a very loud voice
yell.translation: vi. 叫喊, 大叫, (齐声)呐喊欢呼\nvt. 喊叫着说\nn. 叫声, 喊声, 呐喊

examples.en: If you got anything to say, say it properly, don't yell.
examples.zh: 有事好好说，不要大喊大叫！

examples.en: Inside the venue, sounds of clapping, whistling, yelling, laughing blended together.
examples.zh: 会场内，掌声、哨声、喊声、笑声乱成了一锅粥。

examples.en: Do not yell into my ear.
examples.zh: 别在我耳边大叫。

yellow.definition:
n. yellow color or pigment; the chromatic color resembling the hue of sunflowers or ripe lemons
v. turn yellow
s. of the color intermediate between green and orange in the color spectrum; of something resembling the color of an egg yolk
s. changed to a yellowish color by age

examples.en: Tom is wearing a yellow shirt with a blue tie.
examples.zh: 汤姆穿著一件黄色衬衫，系著一条蓝色领带。

examples.en: Tom was wearing a yellow shirt with a blue tie.
examples.zh: 汤姆穿著一件黄色衬衫，系著一条蓝色领带。

examples.en: This flower is yellow, but all the others are blue.
examples.zh: 这朵花是黄色的，但是其他全都是蓝色的。

yes.translation: adv. 是\nn. 是, 同意\nv. 同意

examples.en: Yes, there are. How many of you are there, Sir?
examples.zh: 有的，先生你有几位？

examples.en: Yes, people usually curse at someone they are acquainted with.
examples.zh: 对，人通常会对自己的熟人口出恶言。

examples.en: Yes. She used to be a very shy girl.
examples.zh: 对啊，她以前是一个很害羞的女孩。

yesterday.definition:
n. the day immediately before today
n. the recent past
r. on the day preceding today
r. in the recent past; only a short time ago

examples.en: I had my hair cut at the barber shop yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天去了理发店理发。

examples.en: I wore a hat yesterday because it was very cold.
examples.zh: 昨天的天气很冷，所以我戴了一顶帽子。

examples.en: I, as well as you, was late for school yesterday.
examples.zh: 我跟你一样昨天上学迟到了。

yet.definition: r. up to the present time\nr. within an indefinite time or at an unspecified future time
yet.translation: adv. 还, 尚, 仍然, 已经, 然而\nconj. 然而

examples.en: I am a cat. I don't have a name yet.
examples.zh: 我是一只猫。我还没有名字。

examples.en: I haven't had a chance to see the movie yet.
examples.zh: 我还没有机会看那部电影。

examples.en: We haven't yet been told what we need to do.
examples.zh: 还没人告诉我们要做甚么。

yield.definition:
n. an amount of a product
v. be the cause or source of
v. give in, as to influence or pressure
v. bring in
yield.translation: n. 生产量, 投资收益\nvt. 出产, 给予, 让出, 放弃, 使屈服\nvi. 出产, 屈服, 投降, 倒塌

examples.en: They obtained a yield of 8 percent on their investment.
examples.zh: 他们在这次的投资中得到百分之八的收益。

examples.en: When the light is green, cars turning must yield to pedestrians.
examples.zh: 绿灯时，拐弯车要让人。

examples.en: A 6% yield is guaranteed on the investment.
examples.zh: 这投资保证有 6% 的回报。

young.definition:
n. any immature animal
n. United States film and television actress (1913-2000)
n. United States civil rights leader (1921-1971)
n. British physicist and Egyptologist; he revived the wave theory of light and proposed a three-component theory of color vision; he also played an important role in deciphering the hieroglyphics on the Rosetta Stone (1773-1829)
young.translation: a. 年轻的, 无经验的, 朝气蓬勃的\nn. 青年们, 幼小动物, 崽

examples.en: He used to get up early when he was young.
examples.zh: 他小时通常很早起床。

examples.en: He used to visit us often when I was young.
examples.zh: 当我还小的时候他常常来拜访我们。

examples.en: A young man is singing in front of the door.
examples.zh: 有位年轻人在门前唱歌.

youngster.definition: n a young person of either sex
youngster.translation: n. 小孩, 年轻人, 少年\n[法] 儿童, 少年, 青年

examples.en: They're typical youngsters.
examples.zh: 他们是典型的年轻人。

yourself.definition:
pron. An emphasized or reflexive form of the pronoun of the
   second person; -- used as a subject commonly with you; as, you yourself
   shall see it; also, alone in the predicate, either in the nominative or
   objective case; as, you have injured yourself.

examples.en: Are you sure you want to do this by yourself?
examples.zh: 你确定要自己做吗？

examples.en: This is a problem you have to solve by yourself.
examples.zh: 这是一个你必须自己解决的问题。

examples.en: Is it true that you built this house by yourself?
examples.zh: 你真是自己造了这栋房子吗？

youth.definition:
n. the time of life between childhood and maturity
n. early maturity; the state of being young or immature or inexperienced
n. an early period of development
n. the freshness and vitality characteristic of a young person
youth.translation: n. 年轻, 青年时代, 青年们, 青春\n[法] 青年, 青年时期, 青春时期

examples.en: The youth of our land are not interested in politics.
examples.zh: 我们国家的年轻人对政治普遍不感兴趣。

examples.en: "What craft do you know?" the wizard asked the youth.
examples.zh: 巫师问年轻人：「你懂什么技艺？」

examples.en: When I hear that song I remember my youth.
examples.zh: 每次听到这首歌，都会让我回忆起自己年轻的时候。

yoga.definition: n. Hindu discipline aimed at training the consciousness for a state of perfect spiritual insight and tranquility that is achieved through the three paths of actions and knowledge and devotion\nn. a system of exercises practiced as part of the Hindu discipline to promote control of the body and mind

examples.en: There's a guy in my yoga class.
examples.zh: 有个小伙子在我的瑜伽班里。

yearning.definition:
n prolonged unfulfilled desire or need
v desire strongly or persistently
v have a desire for something or someone who is not present
v have affection for; feel tenderness for
yearning.translation: n. 渴望, 热望, 怀念\na. 热望的, 渴望的, 怀念的, 向往的

examples.en: Nothing can keep me from yearning for freedom.
examples.zh: 没有什么可以阻挡，我对自由的向往。

examples.en: I feel a yearning for the university.
examples.zh: 我对于上大学有一种渴望。

yearly.definition: n a reference book that is published regularly once every year\ns occurring or payable every year\nr without missing a year
yearly.translation: a. 每年的, 一年一度的\nadv. 一年一次, 每年

examples.en: There is also a yearly membership fee required to maintain certification.
I prefer to have a yearly eye exam.
My yearly salary is split into sixteen payments.

yeast.definition: n. a commercial leavening agent containing yeast cells; used to raise the dough in making bread and for fermenting beer or whiskey\nn. any of various single-celled fungi that reproduce asexually by budding or division

examples.en: Bread is made from flour, water, and often yeast.
examples.zh: 面包是用面粉和水做的，有时还会加入发酵粉。

yielding.definition: s. inclined to yield to argument or influence or control\ns. lacking stiffness and giving way to pressure\ns. tending to give in or surrender or agree
yielding.translation: a. 生产的, 屈从的, 柔顺的, 易弯曲的\n[化] 屈服

examples.en: It's a sharp axe, but the branch is not yielding.
Law is yielding: where you desire, there it goes.
You can shout as much as you want, I'm not yielding.

yoke.definition: n. fabric comprising a fitted part at the top of a garment\nn. an oppressive power\nn. a pair of draft animals joined by a yoke
yoke.translation:
n. 轭, 牛轭, 束缚
vt. 给...上轭, 连接, 结合, 使匹配
vi. 结合, 匹配
[计] 磁轭; 磁头组; 偏转线圈

examples.en: The country bore the yoke of tyranny for two decades.
Sahrawis don't want to live under the yoke of Morocco.
In 1857, Kabylia came under the yoke of French colonialism.

yolk.definition: n. nutritive material of an ovum stored for the nutrition of an embryo (especially the yellow mass of a bird or reptile egg)
yolk.translation: n. 蛋黄, 卵黄\n[医] 卵黄, 羊毛脂

examples.en: My daughter likes to eat egg yolks.
examples.zh: 我女儿喜欢吃蛋黄。

examples.en: The eggs from this farm have darker shells, and the yolks are exceptionally rich.
examples.zh: 这家农场的草鸡蛋颜色偏深，蛋黄特别鲜美。

examples.en: My daughter likes egg yolks.
examples.zh: 我女儿喜欢蛋黄。

youthful.definition: s. suggestive of youth; vigorous and fresh
youthful.translation: a. 年轻的, 青年的\n[法] 青年的, 年轻的

examples.en: Yanni is of short stature and has a youthful appearance.
Though he is old, he has a youthful spirit.
Despite his age, he always has a youthful appearance.
